selection_method: Independent primary-record relevance review, then exact identifier selection; other candidates remain unreviewed.

papers.title: FRESCO: Benchmarking and Optimizing Re-rankers for Evolving Semantic Conflict in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.task_relevance: Adds temporally conflicting evidence and factual recency as a distinct reranker diagnostic, missing from the current static hybrid-retrieval comparison.
papers.scope_limit: Historical Wikipedia revision construction and recency-seeking questions require inspection; do not transfer the abstract's reported gain into laboratory predictions.
papers.identity_selection: exact_formal_doi; alternative archive identities are not merged

papers.title: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
papers.task_relevance: Recent preprint separates retrieving any relevant chunk from retrieving all required evidence and scores answer plus evidence jointly; directly tests blind spots in answer-only evaluation.
papers.scope_limit: DataCite DOI is explicitly pending registration on the official page; preserve arXiv identity rather than asserting a registered publication DOI. Inspect benchmark transformations, evidence labels and matched RAG/long-context budgets before importing conclusions.

papers.title: Retrieving Facts or Reinforcing Beliefs? Towards Understanding Confirmation Bias in RAG Systems for Scientific Claim Verification
papers.task_relevance: CoBiT adds claim/counterclaim paired evaluation and separates reranking bias from generation bias; useful for scientific research workflows that might retrieve only supportive evidence.
papers.scope_limit: Official metadata specifies 707 minimally perturbed pairs. Must read construction and metric definitions; raw overall bias numbers cannot be transferred to a new corpus.

papers.title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
papers.task_relevance: Addresses redundant evidence and alternate valid support in similar documents; extends the current concern that chunk gold labels can falsely penalize valid retrieval.
papers.scope_limit: Inspect atomic fact construction, PerfRecall definition, generated QA filtering and domain datasets before choosing this metric or reproducing the reported degradation.
papers.identity_selection: exact_formal_doi; alternative archive identities are not merged

papers.title: SciRerankBench: Benchmarking Rerankers Towards Scientific Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LLMs
papers.task_relevance: Scientific-domain reranker stress tests distinguish noisy, semantically similar but logically irrelevant, and counterfactual contexts.
papers.scope_limit: 2025 first submission with 2026 revision/publication. Author lists differ between repository and proceedings metadata; retain version identity, do not assume byte-identical manuscripts or merge based on similar title alone.
papers.identity_selection: exact_formal_doi; alternative archive identities are not merged

papers.title: Faithfulness-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Fact-Checking the Output of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.task_relevance: FRANQ explicitly separates factuality from faithfulness to retrieved context; supports two-axis claim labeling instead of equating unsupported-by-context with false.
papers.scope_limit: Uncertainty estimates depend on the underlying model and assumptions; 2026 publication is not the first version. Inspect automatic labels, manual validation and required likelihood access before adopting a detector.
papers.identity_selection: exact_formal_doi; alternative archive identities are not merged

selection_method: Independent primary-record relevance review, then exact identifier selection; other candidates remain unreviewed.

papers.title: Genetic Perturbation Prediction Models Fail Out-of-Distribution: A Rigorous Benchmark and Systematic Evaluation
papers.task_relevance: EL-PERTURB uses stratified OOD splits and compares model classes under knowledge/data-prior settings; useful for checking whether the plan tests interpolation or difficult extrapolation.
papers.reading_caution: Check preprocessing, input priors, model exclusions and tuning fairness before adopting a global failure claim. Not evidence that every present model fails in every biological setting.

papers.title: DCAF: Unifying Data Validity, Evaluation Validity and Predictive Modeling for Single-cell Perturbation Simulation
papers.task_relevance: Very recent alternative combining data reconstruction, evaluation criterion and predictive model; directly tests whether prior evaluation plan misses changing target/criterion assumptions.
papers.reading_caution: Reconstructed pre/post pairing is a modeled assumption, not observed matched-cell ground truth. Verify synthetic validation scope and separation of criteria versus model comparisons.

papers.title: PIE: Generalizing perturbation effects across unseen perturbations, contexts and datasets
papers.task_relevance: Population-level effect prediction using curated knowledge and observed response evidence; relevant competitor for jointly unseen context and perturbation settings.
papers.reading_caution: Audit knowledge-source availability, training response evidence, gene vocabularies and exact splits; release-page state-of-the-art claims are not independent replication.

papers.title: A split-control criterion for few-shot adaptation in single-cell perturbation prediction
papers.task_relevance: Direct recent follow-up to the plan's shared-control concerns, extending independent-control scoring to few-shot adaptation decisions and control-depth planning.
papers.reading_caution: Separate calibration decisions, held-out targets and independent scoring references; do not assume a nonnegative mean gain guarantee transfers to new datasets.

papers.title: Reliable single-cell perturbations explain and improve model performance
papers.task_relevance: Measures perturbation reliability and shared versus specific responses; can inform quality strata and sample-size sensitivity beyond ranking models on unqualified responses.
papers.reading_caution: Inspect how reliability uses repeats/held-out measurements; labels derived from evaluation responses cannot silently become deployable predictor inputs.

papers.title: Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across diverse contexts with State
papers.task_relevance: Updated formal State/Cell-Eval reference, needed to avoid treating the 2025 preprint as the latest available State specification.
papers.reading_caution: Verify provider-declared preprint/publication relation before linking stable IDs, then read relevant published methods rather than substituting a commentary/highlight.

papers.title: scArchon: a scalable benchmarking framework for assessing single-cell perturbation models
papers.task_relevance: Open, reproducible benchmark infrastructure and gene-level biological checks provide an implementable counterweight to paper-specific metric proposals.
papers.reading_caution: Model set and dataset scope differ from genetic OOD benchmarks; no method ranking should be transferred without matching tasks.

papers.title: Benchmarking virtual cell models for in-the-wild perturbation response
papers.task_relevance: Explicit unseen-cell, unseen-perturbation and cross-dataset scenarios plus metric-aware ranking; useful for checking the plan's generalization matrix.
papers.reading_caution: Inspect per-task split and preprocessing implementation; a broad benchmark's abstract is not proof of leakage-safe pipeline details.

papers.title: Beyond Expression Prediction: Benchmarking Differential Expression Classification in Single-Cell Perturbation Models
papers.task_relevance: Evaluates DE classification instead of mean-expression accuracy under unseen perturbation and cell-line transfer; motivates endpoint and class-imbalance checks.
papers.reading_caution: Inspect full versus curated/downsampled subset definitions and class prevalence before interpreting accuracy or comparing with DE-overlap metrics.
